dut.va.content:
`include "constants.vams"
`include "disciplines.vams"

module power_reset_seq_top (
    input  electrical vdd_sense,
    input  electrical clk,
    input  electrical rst_n_ext,
    input  electrical enable_req,
    output electrical por_n,
    output electrical rst_n_core,
    output electrical en_ana,
    output electrical en_dig,
    output electrical ready
);
    parameter real vhi = 0.9;
    parameter real vlo = 0.0;
    parameter real vpor = 0.72;
    parameter real vth = 0.45;
    parameter real tr = 200e-12;

    por_detector #(
        .vhi(vhi),
        .vlo(vlo),
        .vpor(vpor),
        .vth(vth),
        .tr(tr)
    ) u_por (
        vdd_sense,
        clk,
        rst_n_ext,
        por_n
    );

    reset_synchronizer #(
        .vhi(vhi),
        .vlo(vlo),
        .vth(vth),
        .tr(tr)
    ) u_reset_sync (
        clk,
        por_n,
        enable_req,
        rst_n_core
    );

    enable_sequencer #(
        .vhi(vhi),
        .vlo(vlo),
        .vth(vth),
        .tr(tr)
    ) u_enable_seq (
        clk,
        rst_n_core,
        en_ana,
        en_dig
    );

    ready_flag #(
        .vhi(vhi),
        .vlo(vlo),
        .vth(vth),
        .tr(tr)
    ) u_ready (
        clk,
        en_ana,
        en_dig,
        ready
    );
endmodule
